answer.report_md: 本页是一张未编号的双序列月度折线图：生成器需绘制百分比刻度、季度标签、图下图例，以及两组带粗箭头的图内说明和长来源/免责声明。所有目标值均未印在折点上，只能按0%–8%、每格1个百分点的纵轴估读；0.85%要求精确到0.05个百分点，远细于刻度，故步骤2最难。月度折点多于季度标签，刻度间月份也难唯一寻址。我不确定0.8%的重复附近折点及私营序列末值1.5%的精确读数。

heading.title: Public Sector Employment Has Exploded Since 2022, Resulting in a Crowding Out of the Private Sector
heading.subtitle: Cumulative growth in total payrolls since 12/31/2022

components.evidence: Two thick arrows accompany “public sector employment has grown substantially...” and “crowding out the private sector”.
“Source: Bloomberg, MSIM. As of April 30, 2025.” appears below the legend.
The two-series legend is centered beneath the x axis.
The x axis uses labels including “Dec 2022”, “Mar 2023”, and “Jun 2023”.
Monthly line vertices appear between quarterly labels such as “Mar 2024” and “Jun 2024”.
